creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A subscription opened onto an existing session replays one event kind at a time. In testing, replayed `layout_updated` events naming a pane's old id (`w1:p1`) arrived after a cross-workspace move had already given it a new one (`w2:p2`).

With names Muster mints, that mints a throwaway name for the dead id, and the tab's tree is withheld until the next layout. A replayed `pane_created` for the old id in that window would add a phantom row under a fresh name.

Seen while writing `a_2P65uM7yI`'s tests, not reproduced as a user-visible fault. herdr keeps the old id as an alias until the pane closes (`docs/observations/herdr-0.8.0.md` section 20), which is why a late event naming it still resolves.

Found by slot 1 of the 2026-09-13 round.
title: A replay arriving after a cross-workspace move can name the retired pane id
